claims: Maintain mechanical ventilation with current settings and monitor respiratory status closely, given spontaneous breathing trial readiness and current CPAP/PSV mode.
Monitor blood glucose closely and administer insulin per sliding scale for hyperglycemia (glucose 216-254 mg/dL).
Continue insulin therapy as ordered for glycemic control.
Monitor vital signs, including heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation, per ICU protocol.
Monitor neurological status with Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale and Glasgow Coma Scale.
Perform pressure ulcer care for stage 1 pressure ulcer, including regular repositioning and skin care.
Perform bed bath and CHG bath for infection prevention and hygiene.
Administer bowel regimen with bisacodyl and senna as ordered to prevent constipation.
Monitor temperature and manage fever with acetaminophen as ordered.
Maintain intravenous access and monitor for signs of infection given leukocytosis (WBC 22.1 K/uL).
